catalog.method: gRPC TLS grpc.dtunnel.com.br:443, service com.app.config.ConfigService/getConfigsV2, request {user_id} (UUID); response field data is an AES-256-GCM envelope (key inline in the response) -> JSON list of profiles
catalog.notes: The user_id is a SERVER SECRET: it lives only in the SPDECODE_DTUNNEL_VPN_REQUEST_ID environment variable (added to /etc/spdecode/cloud.env on the VPS); it is never in the repo, scripts, READMEs, chat or memory. The Node downloader (downloadDtunnelVpn) fails REMOTE_NOT_CONFIGURED when the variable is unset or not a UUID. Decode was verified against the live v436 data fixture; the live gRPC call is re-verified only on the VPS after deploy. dtunnel-mod (com.dtunnel.v2ray.pro) is a DIFFERENT app; do not mix them.

dependencies: pycryptodome==3.23.0 (decode only; the broker downloader uses the Node built-in http2 module, no grpc library)
name: DTunnel VPN
